title: TIER 3 · CELL A-3-N03
text: Something glints on the shelf beside the bed.

title: THE NUMBERS
text: 2 - 7 - 1 - 8. The pattern Raman made you repeat. Find a way into Maintenance — the dayroom rack on the ground tier holds service keys.

title: MAINTENANCE · TOOL ISSUE
text: Cross the yard to Maintenance (south-east). The tool-issue keypad is waiting for a remembered code.

title: ACCESS CARD
text: The card opens more than a locker. Stay out of sight.
